title: GPT-6.2: Astra and Sol, what changed in ChatGPT
intro: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 on November 17, 2026, in two models: Astra for your hardest work, and Sol for everyday work. Here are the sources from the reel so you can read them yourself.
reel: From the reel: OpenAI dropped GPT-6.2. Three things to know before you switch.

sections.heading: What the reel said
steps: Sol is the cheaper model. On one coding test (FrontierCode 2.0) it came within half a point of Astra at about a fifth of the cost, as OpenAI reports it.
It's for paid plans: Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu, in ChatGPT and Codex. Free isn't on the list.
Pro plans also get Ultrafast: up to 4.5 times faster, but it uses more of your usage limit.
Early testers reported loops and tasks stopped too early. OpenAI says it made big changes in the last three to four days before launch.
Try it on a small task first, before you trust it with a big one.
